description:
Protocol-level risk card (age, audit signals, curated known issues, category, score 0–100).

Chain: pass list_yields opportunities[].protocolSlug as protocol or protocolSlug. Display names also resolve case- and space-insensitively via DefiLlama protocol metadata (e.g. "Compound V3" → compound-v3, "Curve" → curve-dex, "Euler V2" → euler-v2).

Unknown names return NOT_FOUND naming the field, with example {"protocolSlug":"aave-v3"} and up to 3 closest slugs.

Higher score = lower protocol risk. Uses curated priors plus DefiLlama metadata when available.

Research only — non-custodial.

Example:
{
  "protocol": "aave-v3"
}
Also accepts protocolSlug or a display name such as "Compound V3".

protocol.description: Protocol slug (DefiLlama project id) or display name, e.g. "aave-v3" or "Compound V3". Prefer list_yields opportunities[].protocolSlug.

protocolSlug.description: Alias for protocol — list_yields opportunities[].protocolSlug (display names also resolve).

name: get_protocol_risk
title: Get protocol risk
